requirements.title: KIND argument admissible type and rank
requirements.definition: X may be any intrinsic type and may be scalar or an array.

pending.KIND-X-any-intrinsic-type: Positive control calls KIND with integer, real, complex, logical, and character actuals initialized to distinguished values; source-control mutation uses a derived-type value and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.KIND-X-scalar-or-array: Positive control calls KIND with a scalar integer and a rank-one integer array with nondefault lower bound and distinguished elements; mutate the array actual to a scalar-only control to verify both forms are exercised.

requirements.title: KIND result is default integer scalar
requirements.definition: The KIND result is a default integer scalar.

requirements.title: KIND returns X kind type parameter value
requirements.definition: KIND(X) has a value equal to the kind type parameter value of X.

pending.KIND-returns-integer-kind-parameter: Use integer default kind and selected_int_kind(18) declarations; 7.4.3.1 p2 requires at least one integer representation method with decimal exponent range >= 18, so selected_int_kind(18) is a valid kind. Assert KIND(value) equals the declaration kind parameter, and mutate the declared kind in the expected value.
pending.KIND-returns-real-kind-parameter: Use a default real value and a double precision value, assert KIND(value) equals the declaration or literal kind parameter, and mutate the expected double precision kind to KIND(0.0).
pending.KIND-returns-complex-kind-parameter: Use default complex and double precision complex literal values, assert KIND(value) equals the kind parameter of the real and imaginary parts, and mutate the expected double precision complex kind to KIND((0.0,0.0)).
pending.KIND-returns-logical-kind-parameter: Use a default logical value initialized true and assert KIND(value) equals KIND(.true.); companion integer and character checks prevent type-insensitive constants.
pending.KIND-returns-character-kind-parameter: Use default character with nonblank contents and assert KIND(value) equals KIND("A"); companion length check prevents confusing character length with kind.
